# BuildXI

> BuildXI is a free, fan-made IPL draft game at https://buildxi.in. You spin real IPL team-seasons from 2008 to 2025, pick one player from each to build an all-time XI, and play a full simulated season. The target is a perfect 14–0 league record. It runs in the browser, takes about three minutes, and needs no sign-up. It is not affiliated with the IPL or BCCI.

## Pages

- [How BuildXI works](https://buildxi.in/how-it-works): the full rules. 156 team-seasons, XI shapes, the four-overseas limit, re-spins by setting, the 14-game season and the playoffs, today's challenge, and an FAQ.
- [How ratings work](https://buildxi.in/how-ratings-work): one hand-set rating from 62 to 99 per player-season, how it splits into batting and bowling, what playing out of position costs, and how ratings decide a match.
- [Leaderboard](https://buildxi.in/leaderboard): today's best seasons, today's challenge and all time, and how the board is ranked.
- [Multiplayer](https://buildxi.in/multiplayer): rooms for 2 to 5 managers, invites on WhatsApp, one shared 10-team league with IPL-format playoffs.

## Key facts

- 156 real IPL team-seasons from 2008 to 2025, each a squad of twelve: 1,872 player-seasons across 436 players.
- Eleven spins, one pick from each squad, at most four overseas players.
- Settings: Rookie (3 re-spins, weaker opposition), Pro (1 re-spin), Legend (no re-spins, ratings hidden until you pick, stronger opposition).
- A season is 14 league games simulated ball by ball; the top four reach the playoffs.
- Today's challenge gives everyone the same eleven opening squads and resets at midnight IST.
- Available in English and Hindi.

## Play

- [Play a season](https://buildxi.in/)
- [Today's challenge](https://buildxi.in/?play=daily)
- [Create a multiplayer room](https://buildxi.in/?play=multiplayer)
